amendment.reason: Make the cross-route identifiability gate numerically predeclared and deterministic before any Phase37 materialization, solver run, or truth read.
amendment.inheritance: All archive, source, binary, input, flag, truth-budget, structural-safety, exclusion, and fail-closed fields from v1 remain unchanged unless explicitly amended below.

identifiability.purpose: Identification evidence only; no common constant is fitted, learned, applied, or promoted in Phase37.
identifiability.route_vector: For each route, the fixed-ENU component-wise median of prediction-minus-truth east and north residuals.
identifiability.common_median_vector: Component-wise median of the four route median vectors, in evaluation_routes order; even-cardinality median is the arithmetic mean of the two sorted middle values.

geometric_center.algorithm: Use common_median_vector as the geometric center. This is the predeclared component-median simplification; no iterative Weiszfeld fit is allowed.
geometric_center.tie_rule: No ordering or floating-point iteration tie exists; route order is fixed by evaluation_routes and component medians sort numerically with stable route-order tie retention.
geometric_center.distance: Euclidean norm in metres from each route median vector to common_median_vector.

cross_route_agreement.logic: All six conditions below are required simultaneously (logical AND). One failed condition makes phone-common constant_identifiable=false and is a no-go.

conditions.criterion: All four route median vectors have finite east and north components.
Component-wise MAD across the four route median vectors is at most 0.50 m for east and at most 0.50 m for north.
The Euclidean distance from common_median_vector to every route median vector is at most 1.00 m.
The common median vector norm is at least 2 times sqrt(MAD_E^2 + MAD_N^2), proving a non-zero systematic displacement relative to route dispersion.
conditions.zero_dispersion_rule: If both component MAD values are zero, require common median norm > 0.0 m (strictly non-zero).

conditions.criterion: For every route, prefix-tail median-vector shift is at most max(1.00 m, 2 times sqrt(route MAD_E^2 + route MAD_N^2)).
conditions.route_mad: component-wise unscaled MAD over that route's matched residual vectors

conditions.criterion: Orientation diagnostics are reported for evidence only and cannot make the gate pass or authorize a fit; no calibrated pose means body-frame vector_identifiable=false.

cross_route_agreement.rounding: No rounding before comparisons; use full binary64 values and exact <= comparisons. JSON serialization is diagnostic only.
cross_route_agreement.missing_or_nonfinite: Any missing/nonfinite route metric, zero matched rows, or unavailable required prefix/tail metric fails the relevant condition.

residual_definition.frame: Fixed local ENU at first chronological matched truth coordinate; prediction minus truth in ECEF then ECEF-to-ENU rotation.
residual_definition.up: Unobservable because native submission has no altitude; never fill from result, sample, MAT, or any other coordinate artifact.
residual_definition.prefix_tail: Chronologically sorted matched rows; first and last 25 percent, each nonempty.
residual_definition.orientation: Nearest preceding raw UncalAccel and UncalMag within 250 ms, coarse gravity-axis/sign and tilt-compensated magnetic heading labels only.

body_frame.policy: Never fit or apply a body-frame vector from coarse raw orientation labels.

failure_policy.missing_or_duplicate_archive_member: fail-closed; no substitute member or precomputed artifact
failure_policy.native_solver_failure: fail-closed; do not read that route's truth, relax flags, or rerun after truth
failure_policy.structural_nondeterminism: fail-closed; require byte-identical run1/run2 and preserve Phase31 champion
failure_policy.identifiability_gate_failure: publish numerical no-go evidence only; never fit/apply a common constant or open validation/holdout
